theme: Dark Theme (Preserve existing dark/teal visual language)

typography.headings: Preserve existing typography. Use overflow-hidden containers for masked typography reveals.
typography.instructions: Ensure all text reveals use stagger effects per line or per word to feel deliberate and editorial. Do not use generic opacity fades for headings.

colors.instructions: Maintain exact brand colors. Motion should not alter the color palette, but can use gradient masks or clipping paths over the existing colors.

visual_enhancers.overlay: Use very subtle grain or noise textures if suitable, but priority is on motion.

masked_headline.description: Headings slide up from a hidden baseline (overflow-hidden container) with a subtle tilt or scale. Never use simple opacity fades.

image_reveal.description: Images unmask using a clip-path wiping from bottom-to-top or center, while the image itself scales down slightly (parallax scale).

scroll_linked_lines.description: Vertical or horizontal divider lines that draw themselves based on scroll progress.
scroll_linked_lines.implementation: Use Framer Motion's useScroll() and useTransform() mapped to the scaleY or scaleX of a 1px div with transform-origin set to top or left.

staggered_content.description: Lists (deliverables, process steps) reveal one after another using a short slide up and blur removal.

page_transition.description: Next-service transition at the bottom of the page scales up and overlaps the current view on scroll.
page_transition.implementation: Pin the current content and scale the next section up from 0.95, unmasking via clip-path.

accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: All motion MUST check `useReducedMotion()` from framer-motion. If true, replace clip-path and translation animations with a simple fast crossfade (opacity 0 to 1 over 0.2s) or disable entirely.

layouts.instructions: Retain existing layout structure of ServiceDetailPage.jsx. Wrap existing semantic blocks in Framer Motion components (`<motion.div>`, `<motion.h1>`, etc) to apply the animation blueprint without altering the DOM flow.

component_instructions.ServiceDetailPage: Wrap the main page component in a motion entry layout. Add `useScroll` on the window or main container to power a scroll-linked progress indicator (e.g. a fixed thin line on the left/right edge or top).
component_instructions.Typography: Refactor specific textual headers into an `<OverflowMask>` helper component (a span/div with overflow-hidden) to handle the slide-up text cleanly.
component_instructions.HeroSection: Implement the clip-path image reveal and image parallax scale effect inside.
component_instructions.ProcessList: Convert list items to `<motion.li>` for staggered entrance on `whileInView`.
component_instructions.NextServiceFooter: Implement a scroll-triggered scale up or background unmask transition for next-service.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content underneath. Ensure readable contrast.
All interactive elements and key informational areas MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="service-next-link"`) for automated testing.
Rely on optical alignment over strict geometric alignment for humanized layouts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use framer-motion extensively for these editorial interactions.
DO NOT apply universal CSS transition (`transition: all`), as it conflicts with Framer Motion transforms.
Do not alter the established color palette (dark/teal). Keep the original site theme completely intact.
Ensure 100% adherence to prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion.
Do not use generic fade-in-up animations. Use the specific custom eases and clip-path strategies defined in the motion section.
